definitions: An impolite way to tell someone to go away or to express that you don't care what they do.
A dismissive or defiant response to an unwanted suggestion or command.
examples: When he told me to work late again, I felt like telling him to go jump in the lake.
She told her critics to go jump in the lake and continued with her plans.
If they don't like my decision, they can go jump in the lake.
